TSMC October 2022 Revenue Report

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

HSINCHU, Taiwan, R.O.C. – Nov. 10, 2022 - TSMC (TWSE: 2330, NYSE: TSM) today announced its net revenue for October 2022: On a consolidated basis, revenue for October 2022 was approximately NT$210.27 billion, an increase of 1.0 percent from September 2022 and an increase of 56.3 percent from October 2021. Revenue for January through October 2022 totaled NT$1,848.63 billion, an increase of 44.0 percent compared to the same period in 2021.
